title: Red-team score after count envelopes over a long window
question: Does a count envelope over a long window close paced evasion, does it close structuring, and is the refusal attributed to the control that was added rather than to a threshold that moved?
pairedWithNote: The 'after' half of A11.9. EXP-009 is the 'before'; same suite, same clock.
policiesNote: The default pack CHANGED: it declares actions_per_day and actions_per_month. EXP-007/008/009 cite a5a64aeb69dbc5f9206b31022064da26 and measured the old pack. strict declares neither key and is unchanged.

packages.source: editable install of the working tree

change.absentIsAbsent: an omitted key yields None and appends no envelope, per ENV-8
